PARENT_AUTHORITY.relationship: This artifact ADDS NOTHING to the parent contract and CHANGES NOTHING in it. It BOUNDS a subset of it for one implementation mission, carries the allocation the parent explicitly declined to make, and re-measures the parent facts that have gone stale. Where this artifact and the parent appear to differ, the parent governs and the difference is a defect in this artifact.

WHY_THIS_ARTIFACT_EXISTS: The parent authority sets GRANT_ID null, IMPLEMENTATION_AUTHORIZED false, and LINEAGE_REDERIVATION_REQUIRED YES for every future DDL object without exception. It froze a contract and deliberately allocated nothing. Something had to allocate, and something had to bound the first implementable slice. The companion addendum allocates; this artifact bounds.

CL1_SCOPE.THE_LABEL_IS_NOT_THE_OBJECT: CL-1 is a lane label from a read-only discovery compiler, not a term of frozen authority. A structural search for the token CL-1 across docs/ops/ returns hits only in unrelated Wave-2 and tenancy artifacts where it means something else. The bounded object below is defined by CONTENT drawn from the parent authority, and the label is a convenience for referring to it.

SCHEMA_CONCEPT_CLASSIFICATION.status: BINDING AS A CLASSIFICATION. The conceptual column names in the parent are DESCRIPTIVE PLACEHOLDERS which the parent itself states an implementing lineage may rename freely provided the invariants survive. This section classifies the CONCEPTS, not the names.
SCHEMA_CONCEPT_CLASSIFICATION.NOTHING_HERE_IS_DDL: No DDL text is authored, quoted or implied. The parent HARD_PROHIBITIONS_ON_THIS_SECTION apply unchanged.

concepts.concept: legal instrument continuing identity (instrument_key)
instrument_class constrained to a closed two-value set
concepts.grounds: I-T1-3. A third value requires new owner policy, not a schema migration.

concepts.concept: a SEPARATE T1 relation versus collapsing identity onto every version row
concepts.grounds: FUTURE_DDL.T1.collapse_alternative_recorded permits either PROVIDED I-T1-2 survives - structurally under the separate relation, as a constraint under the collapsed shape. Having NEITHER is not permitted.

concepts.concept: immutable published version row, append-only
concepts.grounds: I-T2-2. The parent calls this the invariant the entire model rests on.

concepts.concept: UNIQUE (instrument_key, version, locale)
a genuine TOTAL order on version within instrument_key
concepts.grounds: I-T2-5. The currency predicate searches an interval of it; a partial order makes the predicate ill-defined.

concepts.concept: the version FORMAT
concepts.grounds: FUTURE_DDL.T2.explicitly_not_decided

concepts.concept: content_digest present and written with the version row
concepts.grounds: I-T2-4 in its R4 form

concepts.concept: HASH_VERIFIABILITY - the system can determine how a content hash is interpreted and verified
a separately persisted content_digest_algorithm column
concepts.grounds: I-T2-4 R4 explicitly withdraws the R3 form that made it mandatory. A conforming implementation with NO such column satisfies the invariant provided verifiability is delivered by some conforming means. MUST NOT be used as an exit-gate requirement.

concepts.concept: retained content bytes or an immutable content reference
concepts.grounds: RECOMMENDED_NOT_REQUIRED. I-T2-4 R4 withdraws the R1/R2 form that made retention mandatory. MUST NOT be used as an exit-gate requirement. Whether bytes must be retained sits with LRF-01 and LRF-04, both COUNSEL_REQUIRED.

concepts.concept: co-transactional write of whichever optional values are kept
concepts.grounds: I-T2-4 R4. Conditional: it binds only the optional values an implementation actually chooses to keep. A value written separately could be committed without the digest.

concepts.concept: reaccept_required, NOT NULL, NO DEFAULT
concepts.grounds: I-T2-3. A defaulting flag is the fail-open shape Packet B X-B-03 forbids.

concepts.concept: effective_at, OPTIONAL, immutable once published, a property of the VERSION only
concepts.grounds: I-T2-8. NULL means IN EFFECT ON PUBLICATION, by fail-closed derivation.

concepts.concept: effective_at and reaccept_required as INDEPENDENT conjuncts
concepts.grounds: I-T2-9. effective_at answers WHEN the version applies; reaccept_required answers WHETHER applying it invalidates earlier acceptances.

concepts.concept: per-subject acceptance evidence bound to a specific version id
concepts.grounds: I-T3 conceptual columns and HPO-A decision 4

concepts.concept: UNIQUE (user_id, instrument_version_id)
concepts.grounds: I-T3-1. A second identical acceptance is a no-op, not a new fact.

concepts.concept: snapshotted content_digest on the acceptance row, enforced equal to the referenced version digest at write time
concepts.grounds: I-T3-4. This is what makes tampering with a version row DETECTABLE rather than silently authoritative.

concepts.concept: instrument_class of the referenced instrument constrained to ACCOUNT on the personal relation
NO organization_id on the personal acceptance relation
concepts.grounds: I-T3-7. A subject accepts before they belong to any organization, so the column would be NULL at exactly the moment it mattered and would invite a fabricated value.

concepts.concept: NO identifying metadata beyond user_id - no ip_address, user_agent or device fingerprint
concepts.grounds: I-T3-9 and LRF-03. The parent states an implementing mission MUST NOT add such a column on its own initiative.

concepts.concept: actor, role and timestamp recording on the ORGANIZATION-class relation
concepts.grounds: I-T4-7 belongs to T4, which is L1.

SHAPES_EXPLICITLY_REJECTED_BY_THE_PARENT.grounds: I-T2-4 R1/R2 form, WITHDRAWN at R3
I-T2-4 R3 form, WITHDRAWN at R4

SHAPES_EXPLICITLY_REJECTED_BY_THE_PARENT.shape: a stored is_current or is_valid flag on any acceptance relation
SHAPES_EXPLICITLY_REJECTED_BY_THE_PARENT.grounds: I-T3-3 and I-X-1. Currency is COMPUTED at read time. A stored flag would require a system-wide UPDATE on every marked publication, contradicting append-only and creating partial-failure states.

SHAPES_EXPLICITLY_REJECTED_BY_THE_PARENT.shape: one polymorphic acceptance relation over subject and organization
a denormalized acceptance boolean on organizations, users, organization_members or commercial_accounts
repurposing invitations.acceptedAt, or reading audit_logs.ipAddress as acceptance metadata
any application-reachable DELETE path on an acceptance relation
SHAPES_EXPLICITLY_REJECTED_BY_THE_PARENT.grounds: I-X-3. Retention and erasure of acceptance evidence is an OPEN question and no erasure path is authorized.

SCHEMA_CONCEPT_CLASSIFICATION.WHY_THE_WITHDRAWN_SHAPES_ARE_NAMED_RATHE: The parent records that two successive revisions each corrected an over-requirement on I-T2-4 and each introduced a neighbouring one, and keeps the trail visible because the PATTERN is the durable finding. Naming the withdrawn shapes here is what stops an implementing mission from reconstructing one of them from a stale reading. Each is named as a PROHIBITION; naming is never reinstatement.

RLS_AUTHORITY.status: BINDING AS PROPERTIES. No policy TEXT is authored here - the parent states that policies are the database lineage to write, and postures are stated as invariants.
RLS_AUTHORITY.NOT_CLAIMED_TO_BE_ACHIEVABLE: The parent SECURITY_REVIEW.PROPERTIES_NOT_CLAIMED states explicitly that it does NOT claim the required RLS policies are achievable as stated, because no PostgreSQL probe was run. U-AO-1 is OPEN. This artifact runs no probe either and inherits that limit unchanged.

properties_CL1_must_prove.surface: instrument identity and version relations (T1, T2)
properties_CL1_must_prove.property: RLS ENABLED. READ is available to every subject who may be asked to accept the instrument. NO tenant role may write.
properties_CL1_must_prove.grounds: I-T2-7. The parent calls the read/write asymmetry the whole access-control content of this table.
properties_CL1_must_prove.note: PLATFORM-GLOBAL reference data, not tenant data. Scoping it by organization would make an instrument unreadable to precisely the tenantless subject L0 exists to gate.

properties_CL1_must_prove.property: NO tenant-role write path exists. The publisher identity is NOT decided by CL-1.
properties_CL1_must_prove.disposition: PLATFORM_PUBLISHER_DEPENDENCY. Absent write path is the fail-closed posture and preserves the decision for the platform-roles lineage.

properties_CL1_must_prove.property: WRITABLE ONLY BY THE SUBJECT, FOR THEMSELVES. The write predicate is the subject own id, in the shape the repository already uses for self-scoped writes - the users_insert_own pattern whose WITH CHECK is id = auth.uid(). No administrator, platform role or support path may write another subject row.
properties_CL1_must_prove.grounds: I-T3-6, and Packet B PRE_VERIFICATION_WRITE_EXCEPTION.EXACT_PERMITTED_WRITE_SURFACE which the parent cites for the pattern.

properties_CL1_must_prove.property: RLS ENABLED and FORCED. Read restricted to the subject themselves, plus whatever platform read path the platform-roles lineage authorizes - which this artifact does NOT name and does NOT create.
APPEND-ONLY at the database boundary. No UPDATE, no DELETE reachable from any application path.
properties_CL1_must_prove.grounds: I-T3-2 and I-X-3. The parent test manifest states this is a property of privileges and triggers and that a mocked client will happily accept an UPDATE the database would refuse - which is why it requires a real PostgreSQL probe.

properties_CL1_must_prove.surface: audit_logs INSERT for an account-class acceptance
properties_CL1_must_prove.property: A row with organization_id NULL, written by the acceptance path, must be admitted - and NOTHING ELSE new may become admissible.
properties_CL1_must_prove.grounds: AUDIT.TENANT_SCOPE_OF_THE_AUDIT_ROW.what_remains_an_obligation and OPEN_FINDINGS F-AO-15. See ORGLESS_AUDIT_AUTHORITY below.

NO_SUPERADMIN_BYPASS_MAY_BE_NEWLY_ADDED.binding: No policy CL-1 writes may introduce a current_user_is_super_admin() disjunct, a hasRole hierarchy comparison, or any other principal-class escape hatch.
NO_SUPERADMIN_BYPASS_MAY_BE_NEWLY_ADDED.measured_reason_this_needs_saying: The existing generic audit INSERT policy audit_logs_insert_member_or_admin (db/migrations/0042_fib_audit_insert_policy.sql) DOES carry OR current_user_is_super_admin(). Copying its shape would import that disjunct. The narrower sibling policy audit_logs_insert_tenancy_refusal (db/migrations/0067_tenancy_refusal_audit_insert_policy.sql) carries NONE, and is the correct model.
NO_SUPERADMIN_BYPASS_MAY_BE_NEWLY_ADDED.what_is_NOT_in_scope: CL-1 does NOT close pre-existing super-admin bypasses. U-AO-8 measures the organization_members self-assignment path at db/migrations/0031_rls_core.sql:126-134 as OPEN, and X-AO-06 names db/identity-context.ts:217. Both are OTHER lineages work. The obligation here is only that CL-1 ADDS none and DEPENDS on none.

ORGLESS_AUDIT_AUTHORITY.status: BINDING. This is the one narrow database permission CL-1 is authorized to add beyond its own relations.

THE_FINDING_IS_RE_MEASURED_NOT_INHERITED.method: Both live audit_logs INSERT policies were read in full at START_HEAD and their WITH CHECK predicates evaluated against the shape of an account-class acceptance row.

policy_1.name: audit_logs_insert_member_or_admin
policy_1.predicate_summary: actor_user_id = auth.uid() AND ( (organization_id IS NOT NULL AND organization_id = ANY(current_user_org_ids())) OR current_user_is_super_admin() )
policy_1.verdict_for_an_orgless_acceptance_row: REFUSES. The first disjunct requires organization_id IS NOT NULL. The second is a super-admin escape an ordinary accepting subject does not satisfy and must not be made to satisfy.

policy_2.name: audit_logs_insert_tenancy_refusal
policy_2.predicate_summary: actor_user_id = auth.uid() AND organization_id IS NULL AND project_id IS NULL AND before_json IS NULL AND after_json IS NULL AND ip_address IS NULL AND user_agent IS NULL AND exactly one of three correlated action/reason/entity_type disjuncts, all three of them tenancy refusal verbs
policy_2.verdict_for_an_orgless_acceptance_row: REFUSES. It admits organization_id IS NULL, but only for a CLOSED set of three tenancy-refusal action values. An acceptance verb matches none of them.

THE_FINDING_IS_RE_MEASURED_NOT_INHERITED.CONCLUSION: CONFIRMED. An organization-less account-class acceptance audit INSERT is refused at START_HEAD by BOTH live policies, by construction rather than by oversight. The discovery compiler finding is independently reproduced.
THE_FINDING_IS_RE_MEASURED_NOT_INHERITED.what_the_parent_had_already_established_: The parent MEASURED the necessary conditions - db/schema.ts:118 declares auditLogs.organizationId with no .notNull(), and lib/audit/logger.ts declares organizationId as optional at two sites - and correctly recorded that these are NECESSARY BUT NOT SUFFICIENT because a policy could still refuse. It explicitly did NOT measure the policy, recording that gap as F-AO-15. This section closes F-AO-15.

ORGLESS_AUDIT_AUTHORITY.AUTHORIZED: CL-1 MAY add ONE additive, narrowly scoped INSERT policy on audit_logs admitting exactly the organization-less audit rows the L0 acceptance path requires.
REQUIRED_PROPERTIES: ADDITIVE, NOT WIDENING. The 0042 policy clause is byte-unchanged. Widening the generic policy to admit NULL-organization rows would also admit every other NULL-organization write, which is the opposite of what this needs. This is the reasoning 0067 states in its own words and it is adopted unchanged.

ORGANIZATION-LESS ONLY WHERE L0 AUTHORITY ACTUALLY REQUIRES IT. The policy admits organization_id IS NULL for the acceptance verbs and for nothing else. It does not become a general NULL-organization write permission.
ACTOR BOUND TO THE CURRENT PRINCIPAL. actor_user_id = auth.uid(), as both live policies require. An acceptance attributed to anyone but the caller the database itself sees is not evidence.
CLOSED VERB SET. The admitted action values are an explicit closed enumeration, in the correlated form 0067 uses. An open action predicate would make the policy a generic anonymous write path.

NO GENERIC ANONYMOUS OR MEMBER AUDIT WRITE. The enlargement must be bounded and DISCLOSED in the migration itself, in the form 0067 uses, because PostgreSQL combines PERMISSIVE policies for the same command with OR and a new policy therefore genuinely enlarges what uellix_app may insert.

NO CONTENT LEAK. Instrument TEXT MUST NOT reach before_json or after_json. The row carries instrument_key, version, content DIGEST, subject identifier and timestamp. Grounds: X-AO-05 and AUDIT.THE_CONTENT_LEAK_PROHIBITION.
NO PERSONAL DATA BEYOND THE SUBJECT IDENTIFIER. In particular no ip_address and no user_agent, consistent with I-T3-9 and LRF-03, and consistent with 0067 which pins both to NULL.
NOT_AUTHORIZED: Any edit to the 0042 policy clause
Any generic anonymous or member-level audit write
Any widening of db/policies/** or of the tenancy-refusal policy
Any new AUDIT_ACTIONS verb name chosen here - see THE_ACTION_NAMES_ARE_NOT_PINNED

THE_ACTION_NAMES_ARE_NOT_PINNED.binding: The parent AUDIT.action_name_disposition states that the three conceptual action names are CONCEPTUAL, that their literal string values are a FUTURE ALLOCATION by whichever mission extends AUDIT_ACTIONS, and that the parent pins that the events must be auditable, not what they are called. This artifact allocates no verb string either.
THE_ACTION_NAMES_ARE_NOT_PINNED.CARRY_FORWARD_HAZARD: Extending the AUDIT_ACTIONS vocabulary is itself a governed and shape-pinned act with its own lock in the FIB lineage. The implementing mission MUST resolve that lock at its own head before introducing a verb, and MUST NOT assume that adding a key to AUDIT_ACTIONS is ordinary work. The policy predicate and the vocabulary entry must name the SAME literal, so the verb decision precedes the policy text.
THE_ACTION_NAMES_ARE_NOT_PINNED.consequence_for_the_closed_verb_set: Because the verb strings are not allocated here, the CLOSED VERB SET requirement above binds the SHAPE (a closed explicit enumeration correlated with the row form) and not the contents.

ORGLESS_AUDIT_AUTHORITY.WHAT_REMAINS_UNPROVEN: That the policy as eventually written actually admits the row. This artifact ran NO PostgreSQL probe. The proof is a disposable-harness probe obligation on the implementing mission, and is one of the four properties the parent test manifest states cannot be substituted by unit tests.

REQUIRED: ADD a second explicit legal-acceptance state. Do not overload the existing one.
PRESERVE emailVerified as the email-verification fact. It keeps its meaning, its derivation site and its required (never optional) presence on the principal type.
PRESERVE requirePrincipal B0 completeness. Every existing B0 refusal must still refuse for the same reason after L0 exists.
PRESERVE the Packet B callback, login and signup B0 ordering, including the no-session amendment behaviour where signup routes to the verify destination.
PRESERVE safe-next behaviour. The existing safe-redirect handling is not relaxed, widened or bypassed by an acceptance redirect.
REMAIN AFTER B0. L0 is evaluated only for a subject who has already satisfied B0. An unverified subject is refused by B0, not by L0.
FORBIDDEN: REPLACING emailVerified with, or folding it into, an acceptance state.
REUSING legal acceptance as email verification, or vice versa.

EXTENDING lib/auth/email-verification.ts into a generic legal-state helper. That is a redesign of a frozen Packet B surface and is NOT authorized by this artifact. If it proves necessary, it requires its own governed authority.

ALLOWING L0 acceptance before email verification. This is X-AO-01, whose concrete forbidden shape the parent names: a Terms checkbox on the signup form. It records assent by a party whose control of the address is unproven, which is worse than no evidence because it looks like evidence.

THE_MEMO_TRAP_IS_INHERITED_AND_ITS_ANCHO.the_constraint: requirePrincipal consults the memo FIRST and returns without reaching fresh resolution. An L0 check placed only on the fresh-resolution branch is BYPASSED whenever the memo is warm. The failure is INTERMITTENT - it depends on whether an earlier call in the same request already resolved the principal - which makes it the worst class of gate defect: it passes tests that happen to run cold and opens in production paths that run warm.
THE_MEMO_TRAP_IS_INHERITED_AND_ITS_ANCHO.parent_anchor_as_written: lib/auth/database-context.ts:632-633 for the memo consult, :635 for resolveRequestPrincipal, :639 for the throw.
THE_MEMO_TRAP_IS_INHERITED_AND_ITS_ANCHO.MEASURED_AT_START_HEAD: requirePrincipal spans lib/auth/database-context.ts:680-697. The memo consult is at :682 (const memoised = await loadRequestPrincipal()) and returns at :683 through assertEmailVerifiedPrincipal(memoised). resolveRequestPrincipal is called at :685 and its result also passes through assertEmailVerifiedPrincipal at :686. The throw is at :689.
THE_MEMO_TRAP_IS_INHERITED_AND_ITS_ANCHO.A_SECOND_MEMO_SITE_EXISTS: lib/auth/database-context.ts:864-865 consults loadRequestPrincipal() and falls back to resolveRequestPrincipal in a different function. It is recorded because the memo-warm hazard is structural to the memo, not to one call site. Whether it is a required L0 translation point is a re-derivation the implementing mission owes - the parent classifies the corresponding Packet B point K7 as DEFENSE_IN_DEPTH_ONLY and NOT a release gate, and that classification is CONSUMED, not re-litigated.
THE_MEMO_TRAP_IS_INHERITED_AND_ITS_ANCHO.THE_MEASURED_SHAPE_THE_IMPLEMENTATION_SH: Packet B solved this by binding the RESULT of principal resolution on BOTH branches through a single assertion helper, rather than by placing a check on one branch. L0 has the same obligation and the same solution is available. A control MUST exercise the MEMO-WARM path specifically, not only the cold one.
THE_MEMO_TRAP_IS_INHERITED_AND_ITS_ANCHO.ANCHORS_ARE_RE_MEASUREMENT_OBLIGATIONS: Every line number in this section is AS OF START_HEAD and is NOT pinned. The implementing mission MUST re-locate each site by reading the file. An insertion anywhere above moves every anchor below it in the same file en bloc, so resolving a stale anchor to whatever line now looks plausible is not verification. The SYMBOL - the function and the assertion - is the durable identity.

THE_TERMINATION_OBLIGATION_IS_LIVE_NOW.finding: The parent records F-AO-12: once L0 exists, the Packet B verified-subject redirect to /app/dashboard no longer necessarily passes, producing a BOUNCE through an extra hop. The parent ruling is that the bounce TERMINATES and is therefore not a loop, but that the Packet B termination proof - which reasons about a two-state graph - must be RE-STATED over the three-state one rather than assumed to carry.
THE_TERMINATION_OBLIGATION_IS_LIVE_NOW.why_it_is_live_now_rather_than_hypotheti: Packet B is integrated at START_HEAD, so the two-state graph it proved is the real live graph. CL-1 is the change that makes it three-state.
THE_TERMINATION_OBLIGATION_IS_LIVE_NOW.obligation: The implementing mission MUST re-derive termination over the extended state space, and a control MUST assert it.
THE_TERMINATION_OBLIGATION_IS_LIVE_NOW.the_cleaner_alternative_is_RECORDED_NOT_: The parent records that the Packet B verified-subject redirect could target the next unsatisfied gate rather than /app/dashboard unconditionally, and states explicitly that this is an EDIT TO A FROZEN PACKET B CLAUSE which it has no authority to make. This artifact has no such authority either. It is recorded as a recommendation, not authorized.

EMPTY_INSTRUMENT_REGISTRY.status: BINDING. CONSUMED UNCHANGED from the parent FAIL_CLOSED.FC_7 as corrected at R3 and re-scoped at R4.
EMPTY_INSTRUMENT_REGISTRY.THE_BEHAVIOUR: Where a REQUIRED instrument has no published applicable version, the gate REFUSES. Fail closed.
EMPTY_INSTRUMENT_REGISTRY.IT_IS_DERIVED_NOT_AN_OWNER_DECISION: The parent WITHDREW its own earlier STOP_FOR_HPO classification. The withdrawn reasoning defined the conjunction over whatever keys happen to be published, which makes the required set a function of registry contents; under that definition an empty registry genuinely is ambiguous, but the definition itself was wrong. The conjunction is over the CLOSED REQUIRED INSTRUMENT SET fixed by ratification (HPO-A.1 for account-level Terms and Privacy). A required instrument with no published applicable version cannot be current for anyone, so the conjunct is FALSE and the gate refuses. There is no empty set and therefore no vacuous truth.
EMPTY_INSTRUMENT_REGISTRY.THIS_IS_NOT_AN_IMPLEMENTATION_BUG: A deployment with no published instruments cannot onboard anyone. That is the CORRECT behaviour and it is detected immediately.
EMPTY_INSTRUMENT_REGISTRY.CL1_MAY_MERGE_WITH_AN_EMPTY_REGISTRY: PROVIDED the system correctly fails closed, and provided that is PROVEN by a control rather than asserted. The parent names P-AO-15 for the empty-registry refusal and N-AO-37 for a PARTIAL registry missing a required instrument.
WHAT_PROMOTION_ADDITIONALLY_REQUIRES: Published instrument CONTENT for every member of the closed required set
A valid publisher path - see PLATFORM_PUBLISHER_DEPENDENCY
Counsel answers to LRF-01 through LRF-05

CLASSIFICATION.the_gate_behaviour_itself: DERIVED - neither counsel nor owner is required to settle it

EMPTY_INSTRUMENT_REGISTRY.NO_INSTRUMENT_LEGAL_CONTENT_IS_AUTHORIZE: This artifact authors, reviews, approves and publishes NO instrument text. The parent read none for legal content by design, and neither did this lane.
EMPTY_INSTRUMENT_REGISTRY.WHAT_THE_PARENT_FORBIDS_CLAIMING: The parent FORBIDDEN_CLAIMS list is carried by reference and is NOT weakened by this artifact. In particular it remains forbidden to claim that Uellix records acceptance of its Terms or Privacy Policy, that implementing this lifts the LC0 commercial_activation or self_service_onboarding gates, or that any of this was reviewed by counsel. The prohibition is SYMMETRIC: citing this work as evidence of breach is as unsupported as citing it as evidence of compliance.

A condition frozen here against a stale HEAD could silently absorb a real CL-1 failure under byte-identical identity, converting a load-bearing red into a recognised condition.
known_conditions.the_obsolete_global_registry: docs/ops/ods/KNOWN_TEST_CONDITIONS_v1.0.0.json holds 2 PRE_EXISTING_DEFERRED conditions whose premise v1.0.30 measured false. It MUST NOT be relied on as a waiver for any CL-1 control, and it is NOT edited here.

AUTHORIZED_TEST_UPDATES.scope: Updating an assertion listed in the companion addendum MEASURED_TEST_PINS_THE_IMPLEMENTING_MISSION_WILL_MOVE, because the migration or baseline tail legitimately advanced.
AUTHORIZED_TEST_UPDATES.NOT_AUTHORIZED: Updating any other assertion, or updating a listed one for any other reason. A grant is not a licence to make a suite green, and a tail advance is not a general licence to edit tests.
AUTHORIZED_TEST_UPDATES.the_distinction_that_must_survive: One of the listed assertions - that journal last.idx equals entries.length - 1 - SURVIVES a well-formed tail advance and is therefore a live control on the new entry, not a stale pin. Retiring it along with the genuinely stale tail-tag assertions would delete a control while appearing to do bookkeeping.

POSTGRES_PROBE_IS_REQUIRED_AND_CANNOT_BE.grounds: The parent test manifest postgres_requirements.rationale, carried unchanged for the CL-1 subset.
the_properties_that_only_exist_at_the_da: Append-only enforcement (I-T2-2, I-T3-2) is a property of privileges and triggers; a mocked client will happily accept an UPDATE the database would refuse.
The uniqueness invariant I-T3-1 is the CONCURRENCY control for simultaneous acceptance, and a race is only observable against a real transaction manager.
The RLS postures R-CL1-1, R-CL1-3 and R-CL1-4 are policy behaviour, and no lane in this chain has yet run a probe - U-AO-1 is open.
The org-less audit INSERT admission (R-CL1-6) is policy behaviour and is the specific gap F-AO-15 records.
POSTGRES_PROBE_IS_REQUIRED_AND_CANNOT_BE.harness_boundary: The disposable harness ONLY. Never staging, never production, never the canonical local stack.
POSTGRES_PROBE_IS_REQUIRED_AND_CANNOT_BE.harness_hazard_carried_forward: The disposable harness reports setupStatus SKIPPED as its INITIALIZATION value, not only as a genuine skip. A probe run that reports SKIPPED has not necessarily run. COLLECTED must be reported alongside every result - a run that collects zero tests is not green.

TEST_AUTHORITY.MANIFEST_OBLIGATION: The implementing mission authors its own test manifest against docs/ops/ods/UELLIX_TEST_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_v1.0.0.json, whose schema is STRICT and Controller-validated. Its protected_authority field takes HPO-ODS-W2-28. Note that the parent manifest carries protected_authority null and protected_surfaces empty, correctly, because the authoring lane held no grant; the implementing manifest will not.

IMPLEMENTATION_LOCKS.status: SPECIFIED HERE. NOT ACQUIRED HERE. This lane acquires no lock.

required_at_implementation.why: CL-1 writes db/migrations and advances the journal tail. Two concurrent migration writers produce an ordinal collision that the generate path cannot detect.
The PostgreSQL probe and the targeted suites require node_modules, which is ABSENT at START_HEAD. Installation is a shared mutable surface.
The disposable-harness probe is required and is not safely concurrent.

FULL_REGRESSION_LOCK.determination: REQUIRED AT FINAL CERTIFICATION, NOT AT EVERY IMPLEMENTATION CYCLE.
FULL_REGRESSION_LOCK.reasoning: CL-1 touches the principal-resolution path, which is transited by a large share of the suite, so a full regression is genuinely load-bearing for this node. But the four tail pins the companion addendum enumerates are TARGETED and can be exercised directly during implementation. Holding a full-regression lock across every cycle would serialise the whole program against one node for no additional evidence.
FULL_REGRESSION_LOCK.NOT_A_LICENCE_TO_SKIP_IT: The full regression is required before certification. This determination is about WHEN, not WHETHER.

IMPLEMENTATION_LOCKS.ORDERING_AGAINST_SIBLING_LANES: CL-1 must not hold LOCK_MIGRATION_WRITER concurrently with any other lane that writes db/migrations. At least four sibling authorities are live and each has disclaimed the next ordinal rather than taken it, which is precisely the situation in which two lanes can both believe the tail is free.
